decisions.reason: This secure document storage feature is closely related to the firm's identity, security and signature capabilities, so a mature firm with strong absorptive capacity is more likely to refine it than withdraw it after only one year.

An identity-bound payment wallet sits at the intersection of the firm's existing strengths in digital identity, authentication and payments, making it a highly learnable and commercially applicable extension of its core knowledge base.

NFC-based login authentication fits the firm's security expertise but is somewhat narrower and less visibly central to its platform direction, so it carries a higher risk of discontinuation even though it remains related to core capabilities.

A secure payment and wallet framework is strongly aligned with the firm's integrated platform, payment and IAM competencies and its own dedicated page signals meaningful commitment to further development.

As the firm's stated flagship for secure multi-service ecosystems, this product is central to strategy and builds directly on decades of accumulated knowledge, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

Application shielding draws directly on the firm's long-standing application-security know-how and can support the wider platform stack, so the firm is likely to retain it while learning from early deployment.
